item: Climate fetch outcomes recorded per unit and read back from Field data (row 265)
summary: A failed climate fetch now leaves one fixed reason token (kill switch named as such, robots as robots, HTTP status, timeout, ...) in the unit's own fetch record in the library, beside its last successful fetch; never an address or server text. GET /api/climate/fetch-record gives a per-dataset summary for a new Field data file (publisher host, counts, dates and tokens; no unit named, GHCN stations only counted), and scripts/climate_readback.py prints the six datasets as fetched, failed (reason) or not fetched yet, never an unread figure as 0.
